Blockchain is like a shared digital notebook that everyone can see but no one can secretly edit. Instead of one person or company keeping the records, the information is spread out across many computers. Every time a transaction happens, it gets written into a "block." Once that block is checked and added to the list, it is locked forever using complex math (cryptography). This means the history of transactions cannot be changed or faked, making the system very secure and trustworthy.
